title: lt-suite config
description: One TOML file read by every lt-suite skill. Keys not listed here are errors. x-path marks path keys: 'config' resolves a relative value against the config file's folder, 'curriculum' against curriculum.root, 'data' against the data dir. x-regex marks regular expressions that must compile; 'template' means {num} is substituted first.

schema_version.description: Config format version. This release reads version 1.

institution.description: Who the config is for. Labels only; nothing here gates a run.

name.description: Institution and programme name, for display only.

unit_code.description: Optional unit or course code recorded in run.json. No gate reads it.

locale.description: Spelling and synonym set used by the diagram consistency checks.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, for example Europe/London. Empty means the system zone.

lt.description: The Lt address the capture and fill skills may open.

origin.description: Lt address, https://<tenant>.lt.app, with no path. Capture and fill refuse to run while it is empty.

instance.description: Optional Lt instance id. Empty means read it from the page URL.

allowed_url_patterns.description: URL patterns for the browser server's --allowedUrlPattern option, shown in the setup docs.

data_dir.description: Data folder for runs, captures, state, fonts and the venv. Empty means LT_SUITE_DATA, then the platform default.

downloads_dir.description: Browser download folder for the download transport. Empty means the platform Downloads folder.

downloads_mode.description: move or copy files out of the download folder. Use copy when a sandbox cannot delete outside the workspace.

cache_dir.description: Cache folder for derived themes and font instances. Empty means LT_SUITE_CACHE, then the platform default.

notes.description: The notes graph that export writes pages into.

graph_path.description: Notes graph root folder. Empty turns every notes output off.

format.description: Page format: logseq, obsidian or markdown.

file_name_format.description: Logseq file name format; triple-lowbar is Logseq's default for new graphs.

stamp_property.description: Page property that marks a page as lt-suite module output. Drafting skips stamped pages.

curriculum.description: The course material tree the answer skill reads as Tier 1.

root.description: Course material folder. Empty turns week lookup off.

skip_dirs.description: Folder names under curriculum.root that never hold week folders.

text_extensions.description: File types counted as course text.

week_number_pattern.description: Regular expression that finds the week in a module title. The first capture group is the week; an optional second group is the session.

week_dir_pattern.description: Regular expression for a week folder name; {num} is replaced by the escaped week number.

title_stopwords.description: Extra words ignored when matching a title to a folder.

patterns.description: Title and learning-outcome patterns used by export.

lesson.description: Regular expression for a lesson number in a module title.

bare_number.description: Regular expression for a title that is only a number.

ilo_heading.description: Regular expression for a heading in the learning outcomes file.

ilo_kind.description: Regular expression for the kind line under a learning-outcome heading. Empty means none.

rat.description: Readiness assurance tests (individual iRAT and team tRAT).

answers_dir.description: A folder of your RAT sheets. Only page_kinds.py and fill read immediate files when policy or a current choice allows it. Empty means no folder.

irat.description: Individual RAT: skip, ask each time, or enter your own sheet with from_dir. Never drafted.

trat.description: Team RAT: from_dir enters your sheets, ask requests a choice, skip leaves the page.

answers_dirs.description: More RAT answer-sheet folders with the same read and quarantine rules.

kind_markers.description: Content-panel markers. Titles never classify pages.

trat.description: Marks a trat from content text only.

irat.description: Marks a irat from content text only.

model_answer.description: Lt's model answer in page data.

read.description: Read Lt's panelState.modelAnswer from page data into the run folder. false turns it off; module.json never carries it.

tiers.description: Provenance tiers for drafted answers, in order.

requires_accessed.description: The tag must record the date the source was read.

access_note.description: How the user reaches this tier's sources.

framing.description: Jurisdiction framing sentence for drafted answers.

pdf.description: PDF of the module page, once per palette.

flashcard_source.description: Flashcard source file for a flashcard tool.

file.description: File name written in the run folder.

citations.description: How provenance tags render as links on the exported page.

page_aliases.description: Source id to notes page name.

kind_pages.description: Source kind to notes page name.

transcript_page_from_filename.description: Link transcript sources to notes pages named after recording file stems.

hidden_skip_reasons.description: Skip reasons whose items are left off the page.

author.description: PDF Author field. Empty writes no author.

strip_metadata.description: Run the built-in metadata strip on every PDF.

palettes.description: Palette catalog ids; every final export is made once per palette.

print_palette.description: Light palette for print and PDF submission.

custom_palettes_file.description: TOML file of user palettes with the same roles as the catalog. Empty means none.

fonts.description: Fonts. Base keys apply to every output. Per-output keys replace the base family and file keys for that role. Empty labels inherit PDF sans, then base sans.

sans.description: Sans family name from the font catalog, or a file path. Overridden by nonempty fonts.pdf.sans or fonts.diagram.sans or fonts.labels.sans.

mono.description: Mono family name from the font catalog, or a file path. Overridden by nonempty fonts.pdf.mono or fonts.diagram.mono.

sans_path.description: Explicit sans font file. Empty means resolve fonts.sans. Ignored when the output sets this role.

mono_path.description: Explicit mono font file. Empty means resolve fonts.mono. Ignored when the output sets this role.

mono_bold_path.description: Explicit bold mono font file. Empty means resolve fonts.mono. Ignored when the output sets this role.

text_px.description: Diagram node text size in px.

allow_download.description: Setup may fetch catalog fonts into the data folder, after the user says yes.

page_fonts.description: local embeds fonts in HTML and drawio files; google keeps the Google Fonts link. google needs Google-hosted families; doctor warns about others.

system_fallback.description: Use SF Pro / SF Mono on macOS, Segoe UI / Cascadia Mono on Windows, or DejaVu on Linux after Noto fails, for page PDFs and labels. System fonts are never bundled, cut or web-embedded.

sans.description: Sans family or font file for pdf. Set values replace base family and path keys for this role. Empty inherits base keys.

mono.description: Mono family or font file for pdf. Set values replace base family and path keys for this role. Empty inherits base keys.

sans.description: Sans family or font file for diagram. Set values replace base family and path keys for this role. Empty inherits base keys.

mono.description: Mono family or font file for diagram. Set values replace base family and path keys for this role. Empty inherits base keys.

sans.description: Sans family or font file for labels. Set values replace base family and path keys for this role. Empty inherits PDF sans, then base sans. annotate.font_path wins.

browser.description: How skills reach the signed-in browser.

adapter.description: Browser tool used to run page scripts. auto, chrome-devtools-mcp and antigravity start lt-chrome; claude-in-chrome, playwright-mcp and manual-paste make lt-chrome serve no tools. A workspace lt-suite.toml cannot start lt-chrome when the platform config chose a quiet adapter. Restart the agent after a change.

transport.description: Capture output route: sink (loopback POST) or download.

sink_port.description: Loopback port of the capture sink.

lib_mode.description: Fill scripts carry the library inline or load it from the loopback server.

lib_port.description: Loopback port of the fill library server.

js_tmp_dir.description: Folder for rendered page scripts. Empty means the OS temp folder's lt-suite-js-<uid>/ (mode 0700, checked on every render). Setup records the folder that worked.

chromium.description: Chromium browser lt-chrome attaches to with auto-connect. Chrome channels use Chrome's own profile folder; the others use the folder listed in docs/browser-adapters.md; other needs browser.chromium_user_data_dir.

chromium_user_data_dir.description: The browser's user data folder: the parent of the Profile Path shown at chrome://version. Empty means the folder for browser.chromium. Used by auto-connect only. Relative paths resolve against the config file; ~ expands. Control characters, double quotes, percent and exclamation marks are refused.

devtools_url.description: Empty: lt-chrome auto-connects after you turn on remote debugging at chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging. Set: lt-chrome attaches to a browser you started with --remote-debugging-port and its own --user-data-dir. Only http://127.0.0.1:<port> or http://[::1]:<port>, with port 1 to 65535, is accepted.

approval_mode.description: manual, auto or skip-all. Boundary pages always need manual.

max_pages_per_call.description: Most pages filled per browser call. Values above 1 apply only after the origin's cross-page calibration passes.

quiet_ms.description: No request in flight for this long after every key is saved.

max_ms.description: Cap counted from the last write; reaching it returns unconfirmed.

fallback_ms.description: Uncalibrated rule: wait at least this long after the last write.

check_answer.description: Optional Check Answer retries. Setup asks.

enabled.description: Press Lt's Check Answer on eligible multi-attempt items after their drafts are written and verified, and change each answer until Lt marks it correct or locks it, or no untried answer remains. Never on single-attempt items or on pages classified as team or individual tests. Setup asks.

text_cleaners.description: External text or file cleaners run on outputs. Each entry: name, stage, argv, timeout_s.

argv.description: Command and arguments. fill-text and diagram use {in} and {out}; pdf uses {pdf}.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the cleaner is stopped.

casing.description: Lt upload: Label casing colour. Palette copies use the palette colours.

ink.description: Lt upload: Label ink colour. Palette copies use the palette colours.

margin_fill.description: Lt upload: Margin fill colour. Palette copies use the palette colours.

font_path.description: Label font file. Wins over fonts.labels.sans; a missing file warns and continues. Empty follows fonts.labels.sans, PDF sans, then base sans.

naming_rules.description: Label style rules shown to the agent.

palette_copies.description: Write one labelled image per PDF palette, bound by sha256 in <stem>.copies.json. false writes only the Lt upload and an empty manifest.

floor_path.description: Quality floor file. Empty means the engine's floor.json.

example_case.description: Worked example case folder. Empty means examples/toy-case.

required_fields.description: Header fields a case must fill.

members_order.description: Order of member names: as-given or surname.

eyebrow_template.description: Small label above the title. Empty means none.

lms_name.description: Learning management system name shown in delivery notes.

credit.description: Credit line for inset illustrations. Empty means none.

provider_label.description: Name of the guideline source in messages.

ledger_name.description: Ledger file name in the case folder.

workers.description: auto uses fork on POSIX and serial elsewhere; serial or a worker count.

drop_text_patterns.description: Regular expressions for author text dropped from captures.

post_ms.description: Timeout for one POST to the sink.

improvement.description: Run review and the improvement loop.

benchmark_cells.description: Benchmark cells the improvement loop compares before and after a change.
